title: High School Football Coach Realizes He’s Been Caught
description:
A camera was rolling as an Assistant High School Football Coach in Florida was questioned in connection with an alleged inappropriate relationship with a student. Police took James Edward III, 43, into custody after a school resource officer was alerted about the alleged relationship between the two. Get all the details on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
